narrationTexts: Confirmed: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) was charging tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, despite its own comment saying otherwise. Fixed to tax the discounted total. No other bugs found.
